svg.title: Pylon: support issues, accounts and contacts through Pylon's MCP server
svg.desc: Inside your agent, the Pylon capability connects to Pylon's hosted MCP server at mcp.usepylon.com with an OAuth access token, and the model sees the server's tools under the pylon_ prefix. Pylon REST API tokens are rejected. The agent sees the same issues, accounts and contacts the signed-in user sees, and read_only=True drops tools the server does not mark read-only.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
